locator.name: keeps the walked tree at the actions rule 9 says change nothing

proves.facet: Choosing authored Sort, switching Changed/All, opening Worklist and reselecting its family, then All changes/Back preserve both outline families and kept tags and issue no new subject review read.

locator.name: opens with nothing selected, reads no subject, and a late catalogue selects nothing

proves.facet: While the catalogue is held, one review request asks for task context before catalogue release with no selectorId. Releasing the catalogue leaves both outline families present, no kept tags, no selected row or subject slot, and still exactly one review request.
The offer to open task context after refusal clears kept tags at the click and after the task context appears; both outline families remain.

locator.name: brings the selected row into view when the retry of a failed refresh is answered

proves.facet: After a failed refresh has settled, retry causes no immediate tree reveal, reveals the selected row when its answer is shown, makes exactly one review read, removes Retry and retains both outline families.

locator.name: waits for the answer of a refresh asked before the effects of the previous answer have run

proves.facet: A refresh requested by a MutationObserver in the turn showing the previous member answer records the prior reveal prefix and receives a selected-row reveal after that prefix when its own answer is shown.
An in-tree selection answered by another comparison clears kept tags and announces comparison change while both outline families remain.

locator.name: keeps the families and states the subject when the answer composes no family context

proves.facet: When an in-tree answer composes no family context, both outline families remain and are tagged kept, the requested row keeps its mark, and the selected subject slot contains no family label or family metadata.

realizes.rationale: Historical attachment of the already-retired L86/R87 carriage record; source callback adaptation is not a new execution or current native acceptance claim.
